field_evidence: Official Cherwell District Council planning register for 24/02524/F records permission for demolition of the existing garage/workshop and summerhouse and construction of one new outbuilding containing a garage/workshop and store at ground-floor level with a home office at first-floor level. The official supporting documents include Site Block and Location Plans (drawing 24 06 P2) and Proposed Plans and Elevations (drawing 24 O6 P1 - B). Count one distinct planned outbuilding. Geometry/materialization deferred to local OpenCode.
